sources.quote: Our Customer Support Business Group ("CSBG") provides products and services to maximize installed equipment performance, predictability, and operational efficiency. We offer a broad range of services to deliver value throughout the lifecycle of our equipment, including customer service, spares, upgrades, and new and refurbished non-leading edge products in our deposition, etch, and clean markets.

within CSBG, our Reliant® product line offers new and refurbished non-leading edge products in deposition, etch and clean markets for those applications that do not require the most advanced wafer processing capability.

Fiscal year 2025 revenue increased 23.7% compared to fiscal year 2024, driven by strong customer demand for semiconductor equipment systems as well as customer support-related revenues from customer investments across memory and non-memory markets.
Revenue decreased in fiscal year 2024 compared to fiscal year 2023 mainly due to decreases in non-volatile memory spending, partially offset by increases in DRAM spending by our customers.
China 34% [of revenue FY2025] ... Korea 22% ... Taiwan 19% ... Japan 10% ... United States 7%

Revenue increased in fiscal year 2025 compared to fiscal year 2024 due to increased equipment spending by our customers across Memory and Foundry market segments as well as increased customer support-related revenue for upgrades, spares, and services.

The percentage of leading- and non-leading-edge equipment and upgrade revenue from each of the markets we serve was as follows: Foundry 45% [FY25] ... Memory 42% [FY25] ... Logic/integrated device manufacturing 13% [FY25]

Fiscal year 2024 revenue decreased 14.5% compared to fiscal year 2023. Systems and customer-support related revenues declined in fiscal year 2024 primarily from weakness in the non-volatile memory market, partially offset by strength in DRAM as well as increased revenue generation from our China regional customers.

claims.statement: Lam Research's China revenue declined from 42% of total revenue in FY2024 to 34% in FY2025, reflecting material adverse impact of US export controls on China sales.
claims.disproof_condition: If China revenue share recovers to prior levels or export controls are substantially relaxed, this claim should be downgraded.

claims.statement: NAND/non-volatile memory spending weakness was a primary driver of Lam Research revenue decline in FY2024, while DRAM spending provided a partial offset; both memory sub-segments are key demand drivers for Lam's deposition, etch, and clean equipment.
claims.disproof_condition: If Lam's management revises the attribution of FY2024 revenue decline away from NVM weakness, or if DRAM is no longer cited as an offset, this claim should be downgraded.

claims.statement: Advanced packaging chip integration is expected to drive sustainable growth and expand Lam Research's served available market in deposition, etch, and clean.
claims.disproof_condition: If hyperscalers or memory makers shift away from advanced packaging approaches, or if Lam explicitly revises this growth thesis, this claim should be downgraded.
